title: Reversal of a Walk
statement: In a finite Unique Games instance, every walk from a variable $x$ to a variable $y$ determines a walk from $y$ to $x$: a length-zero walk stays unchanged, each constraint traversal is reversed, and the order of concatenated walks is reversed.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying instance is a finite Unique Games instance with nonempty finite variable and constraint sets, distinct endpoints for each constraint, a permutation on $ in q$ for each constraint, and every variable incident to a constraint
